name: Replicator
shortDescription: Our LLM-powered brand operating system: CMS, brand voice, and content APIs behind this site and client sites.
description: Replicator is Lightning Jar's own LLM-powered brand operating system — the successor to our earlier in-house CMS. It stores prose as canonical markdown, serves it through org-scoped public content APIs with edge caching, and pairs editing surfaces (including in-place, on-page editing) with LLM assistance that's grounded in each organization's brand voice.

It runs the blog, customer stories, and reading list on this site and powers client content platforms — saving an edit in the Replicator editor goes live on the site in minutes, with no redeploy. Yes, we eat our own cooking.
useCases: CMS-backed marketing sites with request-time content and edge caching
Org-scoped public content APIs feeding multiple properties
Brand-voice-grounded LLM assistance inside the editing workflow
